storyCards.fact:
Sean Kingston's "Face Drop" reached #61 on the Billboard Hot 100. Kisean Paul Anderson (born February 3, 1990), known professionally as Sean Kingston, is an American former singer and convicted fraudster.

The song peaked at #61 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Face Drop was released in 2009.
